top_signals.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on Snack Nostalgia, Turnaround Plans
top_signals.summary: Dan Fachner, CEO of J&J Snack Foods, discussed the company's strategic focus on the food service segment, which accounts for 60% of its business. He emphasized the strong recovery and growth potential in experiential venues such as theaters, theme parks, and ballparks, where iconic brands like ICEE, Dippin' Dots, and Super Pretzel are popular. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: EU mobilises civil protection assistance for earthquake-hit Colombia
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Aug 2026 The European Union continues to mobilise assistance for Colombia following the devastating 7.4 magnitude earthquake.  Sweden has offered 150 tents and 360 blankets, Germany is sending 3,000 kitchen sets and 2,500 water filters, while Luxembourg has offered 79 tents through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism.
